blurb: Colonial Springs Golf Club offers 27 holes of championship golf originally designed by Arthur Hills and renovated by Robert Trent Jones, Jr. The club is fully private since 2006 and provides a relaxed, friendly atmosphere for golfers of all skill levels. Members enjoy unlimited use of practice facilities, a full-service restaurant and bar, and family membership options.
extraNote: Club is fully private since 2006 · Credit cards accepted for annual dues payments and monthly bills with convenience fee · No assessments, locker room fees, bag storage fees, or restaurant minimums
